actualDefect.SERVICE: The packet denies a service requirement that its own delivered artifact states. Both fixtures (pdftotext -layout, line 20) print JV-043's own instruction: 'Please note: You are required to provide a copy of this petition to the prosecuting attorney’s office.' participant-instructions.md says the opposite three times: 'No committed record this packet binds states a service requirement for this petition, and JV-043 carries no certificate-of-service block of any kind. Ask the clerk ... whether anyone must be served and how' (line 41); step 6 'No record this packet binds answers either question' (line 96); and 'Whether anyone must be served. No committed record states a service requirement' (line 108). The prosecuting attorney is never mentioned in the instructions. The repository already holds the answer twice: the bound official form (above), and the committed memo data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/ME.memo.json (fadc5e312ee3f225d27359efb3c89c7eb2336d919201afd00be39f0b1c7f798b), tracks[0].unresolvedQuestions[0], which records 'the juvenile form JV-043, which states on its face that the petitioner must provide a copy to the prosecuting attorney'. Under DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 A1/A2 (ask the repository first; the family's own bound source documents count as held) a named-authority referral cannot stand in for a rule the repository holds, and under A4 a packet may not tell the participant it does not state what its own artifact states. These bytes are unchanged since the build commit 568aed850, an ancestor of VF02's PASS base b8a2495f4; the VF02 row's statement that it read the full page text did not catch this line.
